scope: Every page inventoried; substantive code teaching and dated claims checked for 94 named sections. Not a claim that all old snippets or external APIs were executed.

native_api_checks: XHR/fetch success, failure, abort and latest-wins
DOM delegation, focus restoration, combobox and image observer
native EventSource matches handwritten SSE under byte-split UTF-8, empty data, CRLF, multiline data and EOF

primary_reference_check.method: HTTP availability plus official page review for changed claims; HTTP success alone is not factual verification

publication: PR checks and main deployment must succeed before goal completion
